Users who frequently use ChatGPT to quickly search for images can now use a brand new gesture to add photos to conversations even faster. Let’s take a look at how it actually works.

ChatGPT makes it more convenient to add photos to conversations

Although the Visual Intelligence feature on iOS has been around for nearly two years, it currently only supports newer iPhone models and is not available in all regions.

For users who rely on ChatGPT to do similar image searches, adding a photo in the past required tapping the “+” button first, then tapping “Photo,” and then picking an image from the album.

Although the process isn’t exactly complicated, OpenAI introduced a useful gesture this week that lets users add recent photos to conversations even more quickly.

OpenAI’s Adam Fry said on X that users can now press and hold the “+” button to the left of the input field to bring up the four most recent photos.

Users can then pick a photo to add to the conversation, ask questions about the photo, or use the photo as part of a prompt.

This new gesture was unveiled alongside other updates ChatGPT rolled out this week, including more accurate recognition of the current time, faster loading and execution of lengthy conversations on the web, and clearer on-screen prompts while users wait for a network connection.

Would you use AI to search for images? Feel free to share your thoughts in the comments.
